decisions.reason: The same client message also changes the no-referral commission recipient to a random existing ticket holder, but the candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording that change.
The decision applies only when no referral code is entered; coded-referral ticket issuance to the NFT associated with the supplied referral code remains unchanged.
The changed recipient selection concerns mints without a referral code and does not alter commissions paid to the referrer when a code is used.
Changing the recipient of no-code rewards does not alter the NFT token serial used as the permanent referral code or its display locations.
The candidate was introduced from this same page-revision message and already encompasses the supplied About-page content; no additional cross-requirement MODIFY is necessary.
Message 156 supplies About-page revisions rather than a revision to the previously approved FAQ copy.
Selecting a random existing ticket holder for no-code rewards does not change which book access, referral identity, badges, or prize tickets follow an NFT upon transfer.
The no-referral recipient change does not determine whether prize payouts are automatic or use a visible claim control; that separate issue is already represented as ambiguous.
The recipient-selection change does not alter the required metadata counters, badge visibility, or referral-code metadata attributes.
No-referral reward recipient selection is independent of depositing prize-pool funds through the Aave yield connector.
The source changes who receives tickets from a no-code mint, not the eligibility, expiration, burning, reset, or carry-forward rules for issued tickets.
The no-referral ticket recipient change does not alter the Small Block winner count, prize amount, draw trigger, eligibility mechanism, or pool funding.
